source.description:
PROBLEM: Live specialist_status views omit purpose and thinking_override although the serving code (verified loaded==disk, dist contains both, source lines confirmed) unconditionally projects thinking_override and conditionally projects purpose, and the extractor returns the excerpt verbatim against the real bead description. Forensics ruled out (legacy SupervisorStatus shape by design). In-extension shaping ruled out (arrow-form maps, no pick-lists, withResult spreads). Prime suspects remaining: (a) inline-path capture reads the bead before description exists (race between createBeadFromContract spawnSync and readBead, or creation stores contract elsewhere first); (b) the harness/adapter layer strips undeclared fields between extension JSON and coordinator receipt. Note thinking_override is request-derived (no bead involved), so a single bead-race theory cannot explain both absences -- check the receipt path too.

SUCCESS: Live status view carries purpose (when bead readable) and thinking_override; cause of absence identified with evidence.

SCOPE: Trace-only investigation first (no code changes until the layer is identified): inline creation ordering, readBead timing/content at dispatch, harness receipt shaping.

NON_GOALS: Row rendering (works); any other projection fields.

CONSTRAINTS: Do not change dispatch flow to fix observability (no added latency on the dispatch path).

VALIDATION: Live view shows both keys with correct values; cause documented.

OUTPUT: Findings + fix or documented cause in bead notes.

SCRUTINY: low
source.notes: FIX IMPLEMENTED on fix/unitAI-beqby.14-thinking-override-param: thinking_override param + forward, THINKING_LEVELS export, passthrough test. Live proof deferred to fresh session post-merge (this session pins pre-fix dist 409bd00c). .14 stays open for that verification.
source.title: Newest projection keys absent from status view despite present code
